verdict.rationale: Online filing is a fair question for a national company registry, so the axis applies. The pack contains only two HTTP 403 responses at robots.txt for mca.gov.in and nsws.gov.in. No published service page was fetched, so nothing shows that company formation, registration, filing or payment can be completed online.

support.subject: As a founder, the core transaction this service exists for (form, register, apply, file, or pay) can be completed online, per the service's own published pages
